svg.title: Enzyme Information — EnzyMind quick start
svg.desc: Enzyme Information. Enter a UniProt accession to retrieve annotations. Review database annotations, reactions and sites. Screenshots show the current interface with an actual service response to the public example. Input and result excerpts are arranged for readability; numerical values are unchanged.
